items.prompt:
Two objects can interact without touching through
A) fields
B) ropes only
C) sound only
D) nothing

steps: Fields let objects interact without touching.

items.prompt:
Two attracting magnets released from apart gain
A) motion energy
B) no energy
C) only sound
D) only light

steps: They gain motion energy as they move together.

items.prompt:
Before the magnets moved, energy was stored in the
A) magnetic field
B) sound
C) light
D) color

steps: Stored field energy becomes motion energy.

items.prompt:
Two like charges released from close together will
A) fly apart, gaining motion energy
B) attract
C) stay still
D) disappear
items.answer: A) fly apart, gaining motion energy

steps: Like charges repel and gain motion energy.

items.prompt:
Pulling two attracting magnets apart makes the field energy
A) increase
B) decrease
C) disappear
D) turn to sound

steps: Work pulling them apart is stored as field energy.

items.prompt:
When a lifted ball drops, the stored gravitational field energy changes into
A) motion energy
B) sound energy
C) light energy
D) no energy

steps: Field energy becomes motion energy as it falls.

items.prompt:
As two attracting magnets snap together, the energy change is
A) stored magnetic field energy changing into motion energy
B) motion energy into field energy
C) no change
D) energy destroyed
items.answer: A) stored magnetic field energy changing into motion energy

items.prompt:
The best model of two like charges released from close together shows
A) stored electric field energy converting to motion energy as they fly apart
B) them attracting
C) no energy change
D) energy being created
items.answer: A) stored electric field energy converting to motion energy as they fly apart
